comment: Canonical env_digest registry (CLAR-DEPLOY-22). Append-only: rows are never deleted; a rollover flips the previous active row to superseded and appends the new active row. At most one status=active per image (zero only in the pre-bootstrap record-and-warn window, CLAR-CP-06-02). Written only via env_digest-rollover PRs (deploy.yml register-env-digest job). Consumed by CP-06 (services/control_plane/fidelity.py) and TST-AC-DEPLOY-02b. status=void is permitted only for digests no persisted snapshot/finding carries.

entries.note: Nominated as authoritative in prose only (STATUS-AWS-TEAM.md row 5, 2026-06-09); never machine-registered, never deployed, no artifact stamped. Built and pushed manually outside deploy.yml: no org.opencontainers.image.revision label exists on the image and no deploy.yml run exists for v0.1.0, so the build commit is unrecoverable — git_sha is the explicit all-zero UNKNOWN sentinel, not a real commit. signed_at is date-precision, recovered from ECR imagePushedAt 2026-06-08 (exact signing time unrecorded; do not read seconds precision into it).

v0.1.0 build; never nominated, never deployed, no artifact stamped. Same manual out-of-pipeline build as snapshot v0.1.0: build commit unrecoverable (all-zero UNKNOWN sentinel). signed_at is date-precision from ECR imagePushedAt 2026-06-08.
